# Vault Clerk

> Vault Clerk is a desktop app for independent musicians, made by Craving Sofa Entertainment. It runs on your own computer, suggests where each file in a messy Inbox belongs in your vault, searches inside your documents, and answers briefs with filled paperwork, the right audio and a rights summary. It is in an early friends beta (0.4); people can apply for the beta on vaultclerk.com.

## What it does today

- Runs on your own computer and opens in your browser at a private local address. Nothing is uploaded. The app needs no account and no cloud.
- Works with the vault folder you already keep.
- Every action is shown as a plan first; nothing happens until you say yes.
- Never deletes anything. Files are copied into the vault and the Inbox keeps every original; duplicates and junk go to a Trash folder inside the vault that only the user empties.
- Ingest: suggests where each Inbox file belongs, with a short reason; spots exact duplicates and old versions; suggests clean names for bounces and stems; learns from corrections.
- Search: inside PDF, Word, Excel and text documents. On Mac it also reads scans and photos of documents with the Mac's built-in text recognition.
- Request: paste a sync brief, live offer or collab request; it matches the catalogue, checks rights status and builds a package with filled paperwork, audio, key art and a rights summary. It fills the user's own templates (contracts, quotes, invoices, split sheets, riders) or one of four ready-made template looks. It never emails anyone.
- Pitch rooms: a password-protected listening page that expires on the date the user sets, uploaded by the user to their own web host. The user chooses what people can do (listen, download, originals, stems) and see (catalogue, ISRC, writers, lyrics).
- Projects and rights: projects are marked LIVE (clear to pitch) or DARK (unsigned splits or unreleased), with the reason. DARK projects share preview copies only, never masters.
- Privacy: the identity and tax drawer is never read, copied out or sent to any AI. Password lists and recovery codes are found by name only. Any AI is optional and runs locally; nothing goes to a cloud AI.

## Not available yet

Cloud sync or storage, hosted share links, team or shared vaults, a mobile app, sending emails or uploading for the user, audio watermarking, app-store versions, accounts and billing, a public download (downloads go to invited testers only).

## Facts

- Platforms: macOS 10.15 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).
- Licence: licensed to you, for good. Prices not set yet. Beta testers get a free licence at launch.
- Beta: apply at https://vaultclerk.com/#beta. Testers are invited in small groups and sent the download link by email. The app isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet.
- Social: X https://x.com/VaultClerkApp (@VaultClerkApp), Instagram https://www.instagram.com/vaultclerk/ (@VaultClerk).
- Maker: Craving Sofa Entertainment (https://cravingsofa.com/), which also makes GenreMatch (https://genrematch.app/).
